customDesign.title: Bring Your Footwear Vision to Life
customDesign.description: Have a custom shoe silhouette or material in mind? Upload your photographs, select your preferences, and collaborate directly with our master artisans.
customDesign.step1Desc: Send clear pictures of your shoe reference or sketch.
customDesign.step2Desc: POM'S reviews the silhouette and verifies production viability.
customDesign.step3Desc: We provide available leather grades, heel options, and pricing.
customDesign.step4Desc: Confirm your bespoke pair and track production directly.
